ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite T1 MUSE Scores

Source: R/data.R
ADSP_PHC_T1_MUSE.Rd

ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite T1 MUSE Scores data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(ADSP_PHC_T1_MUSE)

Format

A data frame with 11501 observations and 535 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • ORIGPROT character Original study protocol , with options: ADNI1, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3, ADNI4

  • COLPROT character Study protocol of data collection , with options: ADNI1, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3, ADNI4

  • RID numeric Participant roster ID

  • PTID character Participant ID

  • VISCODE character Visit code

  • VISCODE2 character Translated visit code

  • PHC_LONIUID numeric LONI Image ID Range value: 25898, ..., 11433156

  • SUBJID character Subject ID used in NIAGADS for the whole genome sequencing data files generated by the AD Sequencing Project.

  • PHC_SCANDATE Date of scan Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • PHC_Visit numeric Harmonized Visit Number Range value: 1, ..., 20

  • PHC_Age_T1 numeric Participant's Age at T1 Data Collection Range value: 50.5325119780972, ..., 97.45106091718

  • Imaging_Site character Location Site of Imaging Scan , with options: ADNI1_1.5, ADNI1_3.0, ADNI2/GO_3.0, ADNI3_3.0_Siemens, ADNI4_3.0_Siemens, ADNI2/GO_1.5, ADNI3_3.0_Philips, ADNI4_3.0_Philips, ADNI3_3.0_GE, ADNI4_3.0_GE

  • isTrainMUSEHarmonization numeric Indicates whether used as training data for internal harmonization within ADSP studies 0 = Not in training set ; 1 = In training set

  • ScannerBatchName character Site and Scanner Batch Name , with options: ADNI1_1.5, ADNI1_3.0, ADNI2/GO_3.0, ADNI3_3.0_Siemens, ADNI4_3.0_Siemens, ADNI2/GO_1.5, ADNI3_3.0_Philips, ADNI4_3.0_Philips, ADNI3_3.0_GE, ADNI4_3.0_GE

  • PHC_DLICV numeric Deep Learning Intra Cranial Harmonized Volume Range value: 992143, ..., 1907807.88628578

  • PHC_SPARE_AD numeric SPARE Alzheimer's Disease Score Range value: -1.77195694185127, ..., 2.95614342195756
